title: Random Remasking Scales Masked Diffusion Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.30744v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) generate sequences by progressively unmasking tokens, but errors introduced during decoding are typically irreversible. Recent work has shown that iterative correction can improve sample quality, yet existing theory fails to explain this given a learned, imperfect denoiser model. We re-formulate MDM inference as a Markov chain on the clean sequence space, defined by a remask-denoise kernel that randomly re-introduces masks and then denoises. This helps us analyze the actual denoising trajectory towards the data distribution. The analysis motivates Random Remask-Denoise (R$^2$D) inference, a purely test-time, finetuning-free, reward-free procedure. To further improve performance, we propose Trajectory Correction Training (TCT), a denoiser-training procedure that exposes the model to its own errors along the generation trajectory. translated_title: 随机重掩码可扩展掩码扩散推理
translated_abstract: 掩码扩散模型（MDMs）通过逐步解除掩码来生成序列，但解码过程中引入的错误通常是不可逆的。近期研究表明，迭代校正可以提升样本质量，然而现有理论无法在给定一个学习到的、不完美的去噪器模型时解释这一现象。我们将MDM推理重新表述为干净序列空间上的马尔可夫链，该链由一个“重掩码-去噪”核定义，即随机重新引入掩码然后进行去噪。这有助于我们分析朝着数据分布方向的实际去噪轨迹。该分析催生了随机重掩码-去噪（R²D）推理方法，这是一种纯粹的测试时方法，无需微调、无需奖励信号。为进一步提升性能，我们提出了轨迹校正训练（TCT），这是一种去噪器训练方法，使模型在生成轨迹中暴露于自身产生的错误。在逻辑任务上，我们的方法展现出惊人的接近对数线性的测试时扩展……
tldr: 该论文将掩码扩散模型推理重新表述为干净序列空间上的马尔可夫链，提出了无需微调、无需奖励的随机重掩码-去噪（R²D）测试时推理方法及轨迹校正训练（TCT），通过随机重掩码迭代校正解码错误，在逻辑任务上实现了接近对数线性的测试时性能扩展。
en_tdlr: The paper reformulates masked diffusion model inference as a Markov chain on clean sequence space, proposing a finetuning-free, reward-free Random Remask-Denoise (R²D) test-time procedure together with Trajectory Correction Training (TCT), which iteratively corrects decoding errors via random remasking and achieves near-log-linear test-time scaling on logical tasks.
